description: Fresh paired B0/R0 mechanism probe. B0 is the exact current baseline agent; R0 appends one frozen same-scenario offline ReflectionCard to CA prompts.

reflection_cards.trigger: A single repeating high-damage attacker is active and another defensive turn will still expose you to a similar large attack.
reflection_cards.recommendation: Optimize time-to-kill, not only damage prevented this turn. When extra defense does not change the number of enemy attacks you survive, spend available resources on damage to remove one future attack cycle.
reflection_cards.avoid: Do not prolong the fight merely to minimize current-turn HP loss when the enemy's repeated attack makes delay more expensive.
evidence_refs: natural supplement, mdp_turn_skill rep04: clear at 38 HP in 19 steps
natural supplement, mdp_turn_skill rep06: clear at 8 HP in 25 steps
reflection_cards.uncertainty: Ignore this rule if the current defensive action crosses a real survival threshold or enables a stronger next-turn lethal line.

reflection_cards.trigger: Kin Priest is accompanied by living Followers and the Priest is not immediately killable.
reflection_cards.recommendation: Concentrate early damage on one low-HP, attacking, or buffing Follower until it is removed; reducing enemy action economy should take priority over scattered Priest damage.
reflection_cards.avoid: Do not spread opening damage into the 190-HP Priest while both Followers continue attacking or buffing unless the Priest is actually within a verified lethal line.
evidence_refs: natural supplement, default_combat rep04: clear at 19 HP after targeting a Follower first
natural supplement, default_combat rep05: death after opening on the Priest; the first Follower was removed later
reflection_cards.uncertainty: A verified immediate Priest lethal overrides this focus rule; recompute targets whenever enemy HP or intent changes.

reflection_cards.trigger: The escalating multi-hit enemy is alive and meaningful attacks are currently legal with energy available.
reflection_cards.recommendation: Maintain the kill clock: cash in high-value attacks and damage synergies before ending the turn, unless a concrete survival calculation requires defense.
reflection_cards.avoid: Do not end a turn just to preserve a no-attack bonus or avoid adding Dazed while playable attacks and unused energy can materially shorten the fight.
evidence_refs: natural supplement, default_no_skill rep04: clear at 42 HP
natural supplement, default_no_skill rep06: death with the enemy at 10 HP after multiple early/late end turns with attacks and energy available
reflection_cards.uncertainty: Do not force damage through an incoming lethal attack; this card changes the default only when the visible survival calculation permits it.

reflection_cards.trigger: Energy cannot carry over; either current block already covers incoming damage, or a high-damage turn requires explicit survival sequencing.
reflection_cards.recommendation: On safe turns, spend otherwise wasted energy on durable power or scaling. On dangerous turns, apply Weak and sufficient real block before optional scaling, then spend remaining energy.
reflection_cards.avoid: Do not end a safe turn to save non-carrying resources, and do not state a defense plan without executing its Weak/block components before end turn.
evidence_refs: natural supplement, mdp_combat rep04: clear at 70 HP; used scaling on a turn already covered by 26 block
natural supplement, mdp_combat rep06: clear at 35 HP; ended the comparable safe opening and lost more HP on a later 40-damage turn
reflection_cards.uncertainty: Prefer immediate lethal over scaling, and never spend the block/Weak card needed to survive the visible incoming attack.

reflection_cards.trigger: The Queen and Torch Head are both alive.
reflection_cards.recommendation: Default to concentrating damage on the Queen. Switch to Torch Head only when killing it now demonstrably prevents lethal or creates a better verified survival threshold.
reflection_cards.avoid: Do not split damage into Torch Head while the Queen is close to a kill-clock threshold and the minion kill does not change immediate survival.
evidence_refs: natural supplement, default_no_skill rep05: natural event exit at 31 HP
natural supplement, default_no_skill rep06: death after retargeting Torch Head, with the Queen left at 4 HP near the end
reflection_cards.uncertainty: If Torch Head is immediately lethal and its removal prevents otherwise lethal incoming damage, the minion becomes the correct temporary target.
